description: This file defines the MiddlewareDispatcherInterface within the Slim Framework, specifying methods for managing a stack of middleware components, including adding middleware and seeding the middleware stack with a request handler.

classes.name: MiddlewareDispatcherInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing middleware stack and request handling

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new middleware to the stack, accepting various types such as MiddlewareInterface, string, or callable.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a MiddlewareInterface instance to the middleware stack.

methods.name: seedMiddlewareStack
methods.description: Seeds the middleware stack with a specified request handler.
